Shockwave therapy, hyperbaric oxygen, and drug-free pain relief in Provo, Utah. See what's possible without meds, injections, or surgery.
I'm Dr. AJ Ludlow, Doctor of Physical Therapy and founder of Stronglife Physiotherapy in Provo (Utah County). For over a decade I've helped people get out of pain and back to the life they love. On this channel:

Self-treatment techniques and exercises you can do at home
How shockwave (ESWT) and hyperbaric oxygen (HBOT) therapy actually work
Real answers on plantar fasciitis, neuropathy, tendonitis, and back pain

Stronglife is Utah County's home for advanced regenerative care: shockwave therapy, hyperbaric oxygen, Calmare scrambler for nerve pain, dry needling, and red light therapy. 

In Provo, Orem, or nearby? Come see us.
Address: 3585 N University Ave, Suite 200, Provo, UT 84604
Web: stronglifept.com
